title: cme-bench: reproducible benchmark for Competitive Mask Erosion (CME)
description: Code and per-image results of the benchmark comparing Competitive Mask Erosion (CME) with CAM, Grad-CAM, Grad-CAM++, Guided Backpropagation, Guided Grad-CAM, RISE, Score-CAM, Meaningful Perturbation, Extremal Perturbations and LibraGrad on six classifiers (ViT-B/16, MLP-Mixer-B/16, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetV3, GREED). Accompanies the article 'Competitive Mask Erosion: An Architecture-Agnostic Method for Visualizing Classifier-Relevant Image Features'. The classifier weights are attached to the GitHub Release v1.0 (https://github.com/Dr-ey/cme-bench/releases/tag/v1.0).
